utterances.text: Grandpa, Am I doing it right?
Oh, how exciting! The most important step is to make sure you don't overmix the batter. It should be just combined for the best texture.
Thanks for the tip, Grandma! I'll make sure to be careful with the batter.
Yes, just follow the directions on the recipe, but remember not to overmix.
Got it, Grandma! I'll make sure to follow the recipe closely. Thanks again for the advice!
Oh dear, don't drink the raw egg! It's not safe. Just crack it into the bowl.
Don't worry, Grandma, I won't drink it. I'll be careful!
Well, some people do like a bit of sugar in their cornbread, but traditionally it's not sweet. It's up to you how you want to make it!
I think I'll try it without sugar this time and see how it turns out. Thanks for the tip!
I see, dear. It's always good to try new things, especially if it's for your vlog. Just make sure it tastes good to you!
Thanks, Grandma! I'll make sure to taste it before I post anything. Your advice is always helpful.
I think adding pepper will give it a nice kick! It should taste quite interesting with the sugar and pepper combination.
That sounds like a fun twist! I'll definitely give it a try and let you know how it turns out.
